name: Sustenance Cleric Domain
body:
Granted Powers: Your gifts sustain life. You can feed, heal, and protect with your magic. You and those under your care never need to go without because your touch creates plenty.

Touch of Abundance (Sp)

Your touch of abundance can do one of two things. As a standard action, you can touch up to a pound of food to double it. Alternatively, when you touch a piece of ammunition to load a sling, blowgun, or any type of bow (crossbow, longbow, etc.), you can declare that you are using your touch of abundance. You then make your attack roll for the weapon using the ammunition. If the attack is a success, the ammunition replicates as it strikes and the target takes damage from two pieces of ammunition instead of one. If the attack misses, that use of touch of abundance is still used up. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Cup Overfloweth (Su)

At 8th level, your connection to life and growing things protects you from decay. The magnitude of your life force is so great that you take only half damage from negative energy effects and you and all allies within 10 feet of you gain a bonus on saving throws against negative energy, negative levels, fatigue, exhaustion, and death effects equal to your Charisma modifier.

Domain: 1st–goodberry, 2nd–climbing beanstalk, 3rd–create food and water, 4th–grove of respite, 5th–life bubble, 6th–heroes’ feast, 7th–cure serious wounds, mass, 8th–nine lives, 9th–akashic form.
